cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
ls -la rt_cache.json
cp rt_cache.json backup_ib/ 2>/dev/null
systemctl stop classicbot
rm -f rt_cache.json
systemctl start classicbot
T0=$(date +%s)
for i in $(seq 1 90); do sleep 3; L=$(curl -s -m 10 localhost:8091/api/runs | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('1' if d.get('loading') else '0')" 2>/dev/null); [ "$L" = "0" ] && break; done
echo ready_in=$(( $(date +%s)-T0 ))s
python3 /tmp/ib_stats.py recalc
python3 /tmp/q_pha.py | grep "16:45"
systemctl is-active classicbot
journalctl -u classicbot --since '5 min ago' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -c Traceback
